claims.content: Among the patients retained in the published day-6 analysis, 70% of hydroxychloroquine-treated patients were PCR-negative compared with 12.5% of controls.
Among the six analyzed patients who received hydroxychloroquine plus azithromycin, all six were PCR-negative at day 6, compared with 57.1% in the analyzed hydroxychloroquine-only subgroup.
Hydroxychloroquine is an effective treatment for COVID-19 and its clinical effect is reinforced by azithromycin.
